purpose: Machine-readable restoration of the historical V6/P1i E/U route semantics for V7 compatibility work.

conditioning_support_rule.name: source_aware_anchor_support
conditioning_support_rule.support_physics: direct k/q at selected solver nodes, with same-layer conservative operator control volume
conditioning_support_rule.nested_high_n_rule: anchored_stratified_deficit_round_robin_v1; N uses the first N entries after the original anchors

common.global_context_rule: The model global context, q-k regional features and scale context are materialized from the exact native 1024 anchor conditioning group with frozen train-only normalization.
common.anchor_scale_rule: The native 1024 forward supplies the anchor-derived shape scale; high-resolution routes do not replace it with a reconstruction-derived scale.
common.fixed_padding_rule: Each route uses the registered per-edge-family fixed dummy capacity. Real edges are unchanged; dummy rows are padded to the route envelope.

reconstruction_rule.method: layer/interface-aware inverse-distance reconstruction with per-domain same-layer fallback
reconstruction_rule.role: Convert direct high-resolution support predictions to the 240825 solver field for the frozen V6 production/reference evaluation. Reconstruction is not the definition of U.

validity.comparison_interface: E(N_cond,E -> N_q) versus U(N_cond,U -> N_q) with the same explicitly recorded query resolution

E16384_reconstruction.conditioning_input_semantics: A source-aware 1024 anchor group provides the frozen native input, context and anchor scale; the E query group is a direct high-resolution model query.
E16384_reconstruction.query_rule: The 16384 query support is the label-independent prefix of the deterministic nested support order.
E16384_reconstruction.graph_semantics: One direct high-resolution E graph uses the existing sparse_kdtree_v1 graph builder and the registered E edge targets; no graph algorithm or sampling policy change.
E16384_reconstruction.global_context_rule: Anchor-derived native context and q-k/scale context are held fixed for the query.
E16384_reconstruction.anchor_scale_rule: Apply the native 1024 anchor scale to the direct high-resolution shape output according to the frozen shape-scale semantics.
E16384_reconstruction.reconstruction_role: The direct E16384 prediction is reconstructed to the full solver field for the frozen publication/reference route; the direct query remains a first-class model output.
E16384_reconstruction.publication_role: frozen V6/P1i reference operating point, not a new V7 result

E240825_direct_control.conditioning_input_semantics: The same native 1024 anchor conditioning contract as E16384.
E240825_direct_control.query_rule: Direct high-resolution query at the full solver-node resolution under the registered E240825 envelope.
E240825_direct_control.global_context_rule: Anchor-derived native context and q-k/scale context are held fixed for the query.
E240825_direct_control.anchor_scale_rule: The scale remains anchor-derived; full-field reconstruction is not required to define the direct control.
E240825_direct_control.reconstruction_role: Optional common downstream reconstruction only when a full-field comparison is explicitly requested.
E240825_direct_control.publication_role: V6 architecture/control route; not a V7 claim

U_v2_16384_reconstruction.strategy_version: V6/P1i U-v2 bounded output-query extrapolation with frozen R2P nearest repair
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.conditioning_input_semantics: The native 1024 graph, encoder input, processor input, global context and anchor scale are retained exactly.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.query_rule: The high-resolution output query is built from the label-independent nested support prefix and is passed directly to the output-side decoder path.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.query_normalization_rule: Native 1024 anchor bounding-box affine normalization, unclamped, with numerical tolerance 1e-6 and maximum normalized overshoot 0.25.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.graph_semantics: Native p2r/r2r/rnodes are copied without adding native nodes or changing native radii; output-side r2p uses the existing sparse_kdtree_v1 policy and frozen nearest repair.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.global_context_rule: Global context, q-k regional features and scale context come from the native 1024 anchor group.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.anchor_scale_rule: The scale/log-scale input is supplied from the native anchor conditioning path; it is not recomputed from reconstruction.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.reconstruction_role: Optional/common downstream layer/interface-aware reconstruction of the direct U-v2 16384 prediction; it does not define the U route.
U_v2_16384_reconstruction.publication_role: V6 valid-only parallel/direct characterization; not the confirmatory production route and not a V7 superiority claim

U_v2_direct240825.conditioning_input_semantics: The historical native 1024 conditioning path is unchanged.
U_v2_direct240825.query_rule: Direct high-resolution output query at 240825 nodes using the U-v2 output-side graph contract.
U_v2_direct240825.query_normalization_rule: Native 1024 anchor bounding-box affine normalization, unclamped, with the frozen bounded extrapolation check.
U_v2_direct240825.global_context_rule: Anchor-derived native context and scale context are unchanged.
U_v2_direct240825.anchor_scale_rule: Anchor-derived scale is retained for the direct query.
U_v2_direct240825.reconstruction_role: Optional/common full-field reconstruction only; direct query remains the U output.
U_v2_direct240825.publication_role: V6 valid-only characterization; not a V7 claim

matched_query_interface.fair_comparison_rule: Future E/U comparisons must match query_resolution and record conditioning_resolution separately; this freeze does not measure latency or make a performance claim.
